verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents its own reporting features: flow performance reports via its MCP server, built-in reports, and event tracking that captures in-app conversions. That suggests it can tie outcomes to flows, but no evidence explicitly shows signups or revenue being attributed to specific emails or flows. Missing for 10: explicit per-email/per-flow revenue or conversion attribution docs, attribution model/window details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
Event tracking — capture in-app behaviors and conversions
